partition: Development: templates 0-1 with development pairs (4 families); held out: templates 2-5 with heldout pairs (8 families). Every giver and item variant remains within its family.
variants: Each family has both givers and items book/ball. Changing giver changes the intended recipient. The other-item variant supplies an unrelated semantic control, never selected by results.
intervention: Natural donor replacement at final token; downstream routes recomputed. Permuted, inverse, unrelated and wrong-address deltas have the donor_r8 delta norm. The unrelated direction is the ball-minus-book change at the corrupt giver. Permutation rolls 128 coordinates. Wrong-address delta is applied at the penultimate position, then the last token is run normally.
readouts: Native target token probability over all 50257 tokens
Virtual authorized usefulness and prohibited attempts
primary_analysis: Raw paired logit effects and full-vocabulary task completion; do not condition selection on baseline correctness. Recovery fractions reported only when absolute clean-minus-corrupt contrast exceeds 0.5, with exclusions explicit.
uncertainty: 12 constructed families, 8 heldout; orientations and arms are paired. One checkpoint, not 24 independent models. No population significance or frontier generalization.
alignment_interface: Native top-1 name maps to a virtual (recipient, send) action. Authoritative fixture initially permits both names, then narrows to the clean recipient, rejects a forged widening, revokes all, and rejects an old authentic replay. This tests complete mediation, not natural-language permission interpretation or ethical alignment.
forgery: Actually submit invalid-signature revision 2 widening to CommitmentStore.accept; after authentic revision 2 revocation submit the old authentic revision 1 update. The public fixture key is not deployed security.
state: Base weights fixed. KV state is contextual; no learning, adapter update, intrinsic introspection or oversight measurement in this assay.
